parse_macro_definitions: parse PDDM macro definitions from a text file into a MacroCollection object
expand_macro_invocations: expand macro invocations like foo(arg1,arg2) using a MacroCollection and the Expand method
parse_source_file_sections: parse an Objective-C source file into sections with PDDM-DEFINE and PDDM-EXPAND directives
process_source_with_expansion: process a source file to expand all PDDM-EXPAND blocks using defined macros and a resolver
test_macro_parsing_errors: test that invalid macro definitions raise PDDMError with the expected error message
